description: Holistic pipeline topology — sources, raw streams, pipeline-scoped processors, terminal sinks/analyzers and signals. Node mainStat / secondaryStat carry throughput and staleness; edges carry events-per-min and lag. Anomalies (stale sources, growing quarantine, signal spikes) surface visually.

panels.description: Nodes: sources (secondaryStat=age), streams (grey=passive), processors (secondaryStat=quarantine pending), signals terminals (mainStat=signals/h). Ring colour: green=HEALTHY, yellow=STALE/signal, grey=stream. Edges: lag messages (mainStat) and lag seconds (secondaryStat).

targets.rawSql: WITH fam_count AS (   SELECT count() AS c FROM machine.events_spot   WHERE '$active_family' = 'spot' AND ingested_at BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime   UNION ALL   SELECT count() AS c FROM machine.events_ohlcv   WHERE '$active_family' = 'ohlcv' AND ingested_at BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime ), src_count AS (   SELECT source AS id, count() AS c FROM machine.events_spot   WHERE '$active_family' = 'spot' AND ingested_at BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY source   UNION ALL   SELECT source AS id, count() AS c FROM machine.events_ohlcv   WHERE '$active_family' = 'ohlcv' AND ingested_at BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY source ), sig_count AS (   SELECT concat('signals/', source_type) AS id, count() AS c   FROM machine.signals   WHERE measured_at BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY source_type ), fam_age AS (   SELECT dateDiff('second', max(ingested_at), now()) AS age FROM machine.events_spot   WHERE '$active_family' = 'spot'   HAVING count() > 0   UNION ALL   SELECT dateDiff('second', max(ingested_at), now()) AS age FROM machine.events_ohlcv   WHERE '$active_family' = 'ohlcv'   HAVING count() > 0 ) SELECT n.id AS id, n.title AS title, multiIf(n.subTitle = 'stream', '', n.subTitle) AS subTitle, multiIf(   n.interval_seconds > 0 AND '$display' = 'staleness',     concat(toString(toInt64(round(n.secondaryStat, 0))), '/', toString(n.interval_seconds), 's'),   n.interval_seconds > 0,     multiIf(n.interval_seconds >= 86400, concat(toString(intDiv(n.interval_seconds, 86400)), 'd'),             n.interval_seconds >= 3600,  concat(toString(intDiv(n.interval_seconds, 3600)), 'h'),             n.interval_seconds >= 60,    concat(toString(intDiv(n.interval_seconds, 60)), 'm'),                                           concat(toString(n.interval_seconds), 's')),   '$display' = 'staleness', concat(toString(coalesce((SELECT max(age) FROM fam_age), 0)), 's'),   n.id LIKE 'signals/%', toString(coalesce(sig.c, 0)),   '$display' = 'throughput' OR '$display' = 'all',     concat(toString(coalesce((SELECT sum(c) FROM fam_count), 0)), ' events'),   '' ) AS mainStat, multiIf(   n.interval_seconds > 0 AND ('$display' = 'throughput' OR '$display' = 'all'),     concat(toString(coalesce(src.c, 0)), ' events'),   n.interval_seconds > 0, '',   n.id LIKE 'raw.%' OR n.id LIKE '%.out', '',   n.subTitle = 'pending', 'pending',   n.id LIKE 'signals/%', n.subTitle,   '' ) AS secondaryStat, n.arc__green AS arc__green, n.arc__yellow AS arc__yellow, n.arc__red AS arc__red, multiIf(   n.interval_seconds > 0, toFloat64(0),   n.id LIKE 'raw.%', toFloat64(200),   n.id LIKE '%/normalizer', toFloat64(400),   n.id LIKE '%.out', toFloat64(560),   n.id LIKE '%/clickhouse-sink', toFloat64(700),   n.id LIKE '%/statistical-analyzer', toFloat64(780),   n.id LIKE 'signals/%', toFloat64(1000),   n.id = 'quarantine', toFloat64(1000),   toFloat64(700) ) AS x, multiIf(   n.interval_seconds > 0, toFloat64(toInt64(cityHash64(n.id) % 200)),   toFloat64(100) ) AS y FROM machine.v_topology_nodes n LEFT JOIN src_count src ON src.id = n.id LEFT JOIN sig_count sig ON sig.id = n.id WHERE n.family = '$active_family' AND (   '$source' = 'All'   OR n.id IN (SELECT '$source' AS id UNION ALL SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source = '$source' UNION ALL SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (   SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source = '$source') UNION ALL SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (   SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (     SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source = '$source')) UNION ALL SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (   SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (     SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (       SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source = '$source'))) UNION ALL SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (   SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (     SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (       SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (         SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source = '$source'))))) ) ORDER BY n.id

SELECT e.id AS id, e.source AS source, e.target AS target, concat(toString(toInt64(round(e.secondaryStat * 1000, 0))), 'ms') AS mainStat, concat(toString(toInt64(round(e.mainStat, 0))), ' msg') AS secondaryStat FROM machine.v_topology_edges e WHERE e.source IN (SELECT id FROM machine.v_topology_nodes WHERE family = '$active_family') AND (   '$source' = 'All'   OR e.source IN (SELECT '$source' AS id UNION ALL SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source = '$source' UNION ALL SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (   SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source = '$source') UNION ALL SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (   SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (     SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source = '$source')) UNION ALL SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (   SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (     SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (       SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source = '$source'))) UNION ALL SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (   SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (     SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (       SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source IN (         SELECT target FROM machine.v_topology_edges WHERE source = '$source'))))) )

panels.title: ${active_family} Pipeline

panels.description: Nodes whose subTitle is not HEALTHY/healthy/stream/active — i.e. stale sources, processors with errors, or pending quarantine.

targets.rawSql: SELECT id AS Component, subTitle AS Status, round(mainStat, 2) AS Value, round(secondaryStat, 0) AS "Age/Pending" FROM machine.v_topology_nodes WHERE subTitle NOT IN ('HEALTHY', 'healthy', 'stream', 'active') ORDER BY subTitle, mainStat DESC

panels.title: Anomalies — non-healthy components

panels.description: Per-detector signal volume in the last hour, grouped by source family. High counts under staleness usually indicate an upstream source has stopped feeding.

targets.rawSql: SELECT source_type AS Family, detector AS Detector, count() AS "Count (1h)", max(measured_at) AS "Last" FROM machine.signals WHERE measured_at > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY source_type, detector ORDER BY "Count (1h)" DESC
